contact.transform: Full contact sheet resized from 1280×3168 with Lanczos; no cropping. Optimized progressive JPEG, quality 45, 4:2:0 chroma subsampling.
contact.visualReview: All 16 shots, scope labels and timing labels remain recognizable in the compressed overview; full captions are provided separately.

scopeLimits.realchat: One-account Test Raid · Real Twitch Chat on babafesti, shown through the public Twitch player and matching OBS source. No actual incoming raid, cross-channel audience test, synthetic Twitch participants, or measured retention improvement is claimed.

scopeLimits.simulation: Synthetic gameplay and local enforced-policy demonstrations are explicitly labeled LOCAL SIMULATION.
scopeLimits.codex: Genuine Codex excerpts show the shared contract and later parallel enhancement work. Original round-generation concurrency is shown separately as timestamped records in a labeled still summary.

editNotes: The public Twitch player and matching OBS broadcast show a one-account Test Raid · Real Twitch Chat on babafesti. No actual incoming raid, cross-channel audience, synthetic Twitch participants, or measured audience-retention improvement is claimed.
Afterglow 1 is the observed recently active tagged-raider count, not a five-minute retention measurement.

Public-player and dashboard capture clips were reconstructed at their recorded timestamp cadence, repeating captured frames at 30fps without interpolation. Capture gaps over one second were cut; no frame is held across a recording gap. Those clips have silent AAC because their source screenshots have no audio.
OBS excerpts retain original cue audio at original pacing. Codex source recordings and evidence cards are silent. No added music or narration; every clip plays at 1x.
Local synthetic gameplay and local enforced-policy demonstrations are labeled LOCAL SIMULATION. The real-chat test does not represent an actual Twitch raid.

The hosted authority card documents a separate isolated production Room.raid probe with fictional channels: 1475ms start, verified signed evaluation and binding, but receipt finalization timed out. It is not footage of a real Twitch raid.

The Codex video excerpts show the real current round contract and three enhancement workers. Original round-generation concurrency is documented separately by an explicitly labeled still evidence summary.
The approval source begins with Trust next time already selected, then captures successful acceptance and the resulting active Siege state. It does not claim to capture the checkbox click itself.

Original source files are preserved. Source intervals, original SHA256 hashes, privacy masks, and screenshot-to-frame mappings are recorded in twitchreview/provenance.json, localreview/provenance.json, codexreview/provenance.json, and evidence/provenance.json.

Policy close-ups preserve source time and all relevant evidence: approval uses fixed crop x286,y190,w1112,h650; BLOCK preserves the full dashboard for 1.5 seconds, then hard-cuts to x910,y24,w484,h280 at that same source moment. Exact transformations and original/derived hashes are in localreview/focus.json.

audits.sampling: Actual first, middle and last frames of all 16 shots; parent independently reviewed the contact sheet and key original proof frames.
audits.lowMotionReview: Whole-frame low-motion reports are expected for static evidence cards, quiet Codex/dashboard/end-card UI, and small changing arena regions. Reviewed timer, keyword, meter and state changes remain visible in the real source sequence. No extra frame holds or interpolation were inserted, and screenshot capture gaps above one second were excluded.

scopeNotice: Scopes are editor declarations. Format checks do not prove that footage is live or that a claim is true.
sourceReferenceNotice: Capture and review paths are repository-relative identifiers under ignored artifacts/. They identify retained evidence by hash; private absolute paths and credentials are omitted.
